Tired of fighting monolithic AI agent architectures that break every time you want to add a new capability? 

DeepSeek Harness completely reimagines AI agent infrastructure with an innovative everything-is-a-plugin architecture powered by Cordis for ultimate modularity. 🚀

Say goodbye to rigid codebases. DeepSeek Harness provides an open-source agent harness and development framework that solves the inflexibility of traditional AI systems by enforcing a modular, plugin-first design philosophy. 

🔥 Key Features:
• Everything-is-a-plugin architecture ensuring high modularity and extensibility for complex agentic workflows.
• Powered by Cordis, implementing a cutting-edge programming paradigm for spatiotemporal composability.
• Built-in Web UI accessible via simple npm execution or source checkout for seamless local interaction.
• Comprehensive developer tooling supporting custom plugin creation with discoverability via GitHub topics.

Whether you are an AI engineer, backend developer, or systems architect, this allows you to easily extend, swap, or scale agent capabilities without rewriting monolithic code. Build custom modular AI agent workflows with hot-swappable tools and rapidly develop and publish open-source extensions using the dsh-plugin ecosystem. 

Stop wrestling with your agent framework and start building with true modularity today.

Check it out on GitHub and star the project:
https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness

Ever tried reviewing code or running a quick terminal session on your iPhone using a remote desktop app, only to be met with tiny text, awkward scaling, and useless black bars? 📱💥

Snug bridges the UX gap between desktop macOS and mobile touch interfaces by dynamically generating device-tailored virtual displays for remote desktop sessions. Designed natively for macOS and the UU Remote app, Snug provisions custom, aspect-ratio-matched virtual screens specifically for your phone or tablet while seamlessly mapping your touch gestures to native macOS behaviors. 

✨ Key Features:
• Dynamic Virtual Architecture: Automatically creates dedicated virtual displays per connected device with precise HiDPI scaling and zero black bars.
• Native Touch Translation: Maps single-finger touch, long-press context menus, and scrolling inertia directly to your mobile touchscreen.
• Mobile-Optimized Window Management: Easily launch, switch, resize, and close any macOS app, terminal, or background process on the go.
• Developer-Ready Scaling: Automatically adjusts typography and element density for tools like VS Code, Cursor, Zed, and Ghostty so text stays readable on smaller screens.

Whether you are monitoring long-running compilation tasks, reviewing PRs, or interacting with terminal-based AI coding agents from an iPad while away from your desk, Snug turns your secondary devices into genuinely usable developer stations. Plus, the codebase serves as an incredible Swift and SwiftUI reference for managing macOS virtual displays and window server APIs.

👉 Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/zephyr4123/snug

Tired of constantly losing admin access to your ISP gateway because of rotating TR-069 credentials? 

Bypass rotating ISP credentials and regain full administrative control of your Unionman UNG220Z optical network terminal with a single Python script. 

The Unionman UNG220Z (commonly deployed by China Mobile) relies on frequently expiring, remote-managed administrator passwords that lock you out of your own hardware. This open-source tool automates Telnet activation, unlocks restricted management sessions, decrypts internal configuration databases, and extracts every credential you need.

Key Features:
- Automated Telnet enablement via targeted CGI frame requests to bypass locked management interfaces
- Internal configuration database decryption using built-in utility commands like sidbg to access plain-text XML data
- Comprehensive credential aggregation extracting Web accounts, Telnet passwords, PPPoE settings, Wi-Fi keys, and root hashes
- Zero external dependency design requiring only Python 3 standard libraries for execution

Whether you are migrating your broadband PPPoE configurations during a custom home router upgrade or conducting a local security audit on your gateway, this script streamlines the entire hardware debugging workflow. Systems engineers and embedded developers can also study the repo to understand real-world CGI backdoor mechanisms and device config parsing techniques.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/Hut-hzf/ung220z-tool

What happens when a swarm of 1,000 agents writes 640k lines of pure Python rules to build a chatbot without neural weights or training?

Meet PyBot by Hugging Face. While the entire industry races toward heavier LLMs and massive GPU clusters, this project explores the absolute limits of deterministic, rule-based conversational agents. 

Instead of relying on neural network weights, PyBot operates entirely on if-else branches, regex patterns, and massive lookup tables. It was built entirely by a swarm of over 1,000 autonomous agents that generated and evaluated more than 5,000 code versions alongside 550,000 lines of tests. 

Key Architectural Highlights:
- Zero-weight architecture requiring no machine learning model downloads or GPU acceleration.
- Modular design featuring a dedicated understanding engine, massive structured knowledge base, memory store, and response composer.
- Completely deterministic execution with zero external package dependencies—just Python 3.8+ and optional seed controls for fully reproducible outputs.

For AI researchers and software engineers, this repository serves as a fascinating architectural contrast to traditional LLM development, offering deep insights into multi-agent code generation, automated testing strategies, and massive-scale rule orchestration.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/huggingface/pybot

🎮 Turn Claude Code into an automated video clipping and monetization engine for live gaming streams! 🚀

Building vertical video content for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts takes hours of manual work. Finding the best highlights, cutting 1080x1920 layouts, adding accurate word-by-word captions, and normalizing audio for platforms is a massive bottleneck for developer-creators and AI engineers.

Enter Bodila51/gtavi-claudecode—a specialized Claude Code plugin that completely automates the process of finding, cutting, captioning, and validating vertical video clips from live gaming streams. 

🔥 Key Features:

⚡ Moment Detection Engine: Automatically scores highlights using audio loudness spikes, hype words, YouTube most replayed metrics, and live chat velocity.
🎬 Dual-Layout Video Cutter: Generates 1080x1920 vertical clips featuring word-by-word captions, hook overlays, -14 LUFS audio normalization, and facecam-on-top or blurred background layouts.
🔴 Live Stream Monitoring: Records live streams and cuts clips dynamically whenever chat activity surges.
🌍 Multi-Language & Compliance Pipeline: Translates clips into 5 languages with localized captions and checks output against campaign rules prior to posting.

💡 Why Developers Love It:
It serves as a practical blueprint for building AI agent plugins that orchestrate complex media pipelines combining external APIs, local CLI tools like ffmpeg and yt-dlp, and AI transcription models like faster-whisper. You can easily adapt the modular script structure to automate video content generation for podcasts, webinars, and developer conference talks!

🔗 Check it out on GitHub and drop a star to support the project:
